# Issue 807: final publication closeout

Published carrier: [7d0b10f06](https://github.com/corca-ai/charness/commit/7d0b10f066270d038ea881fba954458ca8c5cca5).

Operational readback: confirmed: issue_verify_closeout@gh via backend-state-readback (state-and-carrier-checks-only). Issue #807 was auto-closed and verified after the five implementation issues. No manual close fallback.

Classification: feature

JTBD: Publish one integrated long-delegation improvement, observe the actual public and installed composition, preserve the original candidate/no-plugin findings, and complete ordered child closeout before the guarded parent operation.

Boundary: Approved Goal 805 and six Work Items, one v8.5.0 publication, relevant installed behavior, A1-A6 evidence audit and implementation-child states. No second release, general efficiency claim, clean low-tier replication, new-session loading, whole-install identity, unrelated #764 work or AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md edit.

Resolution Brief: Execute the existing release owner, reuse completed release and prepared-claims reviews, obtain a separate public/installed observer, then close implementation children, this publication child and the parent in order. The frozen draft and living learned contracts retain the approved scope; no new decision remains for this publication carrier.

Implementation: v8.5.0 is published at fa8fe8834cb748dc5652442080d443027c407a87. Required final-current release verification passed; preparation honestly deferred pytest-release. The actual supported update succeeded. Separate observer established credential-free release/tag readbacks, tag-pinned original results and relevant installed mixed-bundle behavior. The exact tag Quality Core run 34018833489 completed successfully. All five implementation children were auto-closed by 0eff83280a852dff0f4652b11c179c50c2b9a18e, then verified CLOSED with exact final issue-owned comments.

Prevention: Existing final-current receipt, source/delivery binding, per-target classification floors, public/install observation and exact Goal graph checks remain. Runtime evidence now retains the seven original selected rows durably. No check was weakened; wrong-scope and wrong-hash parent rework remains visible in the critique and retro.

Behavior #807: verified within the approved publication boundary through distinct release backend and credential-free public REST/tag readbacks, a separate agent's installed-source mixed-bundle composition test, and source/manifest equivalence observation. All 1,113 frozen entries exist with matching modes on compared surfaces; 1,111 contents match and two metadata differences are proven version-only. All 17 retained pilot inputs match. Retained Codex support/bytecode extras prevent whole-install identity; active hosts were not restarted. These channels are separate from this issue's later CLOSED state.

Acceptance audit: charness-artifacts/goal-runs/805/parent-terminal-obligation.md maps every A1-A6 condition to original evidence and explicit limitations. High candidate passed equal acceptance but cost 33.4 percent more time; low pure-candidate attribution is invalid. Spec intervention and incomplete report provenance remain. Concrete operations were removed, but total lifecycle net saving is unestablished. Child-before-parent ordering intentionally leaves #805 open until its dedicated guarded close.

Review and observation evidence: charness-artifacts/critique/2026-09-06-goal805-release-8-5-0.md; charness-artifacts/release-review/2026-09-06-v8.5.0-prepared-claims-review.json; charness-artifacts/probe/2026-09-06-v8.5.0-independent-observer.json; charness-artifacts/goal-runs/805/reviews/implementation-close-verified.yaml and tag-ci-readback.json; charness-artifacts/retro/2026-09-06-session-retro-2.md. The completed material release review and distinct installed observer are reused; a formatting-only publication review is not added.
